### What does this PR do?

Adds experimental teacher-generated rollouts for distillation. A user function chooses the student or teacher once per training batch; the existing teacher server generates teacher responses and scores the completed sequences. Validation always uses the student. With no selector, training keeps its existing behavior.

Addresses #8334. This stays a draft pending RFC feedback and human review.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Searched [related PRs](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+teacher+rollout); no duplicate found. #7998 discusses the related external-agent path.
- [x] Title follows the project format.

### Test

- **CPU:** 183 passed, 10 pre-existing critic-configuration tests skipped. All pre-commit checks passed.
- **GPU:** six cases passed on **8 H200s** using Qwen3-0.6B / Qwen3-1.7B: four actor/student GPUs and four teacher replicas. Each batch had seven real prompts plus one padding row; responses were capped at 32 tokens with top-k=8.

| Case | Generation source by step |
| --- | --- |
| Upstream baseline | Student, student, student |
| Feature disabled | Student, student, student |
| Teacher-only | Teacher, teacher, teacher |
| Mixed | Teacher, student, teacher |
| Resume from step 3 | Teacher, student at steps 4–5 |
| Custom policy | Student, teacher, teacher |

All **17 optimizer updates** had finite loss and gradients on all four actor ranks. All **48 validation responses** came from the student. Source tags, teacher scoring, padding masks, and checkpoint restoration passed independent artifact checks. Tested commit: `8029bfb5`.

These are execution checks; model quality and convergence were not evaluated. An unchanged upstream metric fails when an actor rank contains only padding; the tested batches keep real tokens on every rank.

<details>
<summary>CPU test and pre-commit commands</summary>

```bash
uv run --frozen --all-packages --extra cpu python -m pytest -q \
  tests/workers/config tests/trainer/ppo/v1/test_reissue_inflight_on_cpu.py \
  tests/experimental/test_teacher_rollout_{config,source}_on_cpu.py \
  tests/experimental/agent_loop/test_teacher_rollout_on_cpu.py \
  tests/trainer/ppo/v1/test_{agent_loop_tq,trainer_base,teacher_rollout_metrics}_on_cpu.py \
  tests/trainer/test_teacher_rollout_loss_on_cpu.py \
  tests/experimental/agent_loop/test_agent_loop_extra_fields_schema_on_cpu.py \
  tests/workers/test_{distillation_topk_symmetry,megatron_distillation_only}_on_cpu.py
pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure --color=never
```

</details>

### API and Usage Example

```yaml
distillation:
  rollout_source_selector:
    path: pkg://verl.experimental.teacher_rollout
    name: select_source
    kwargs: {teacher_probability: 0.5}
```

Custom selectors receive `batch`, `global_step`, and `seed`, and return `"student"` or `"teacher"`. The built-in selector derives reproducible choices from the seed and step.

Initial support: synchronous V1, vLLM, one teacher model, single-turn text, and supervised `forward_kl_topk`. Use temperature `1.0`, disable policy gradients and task rewards, and set `rollout.calculate_log_probs=False`.

### Design & Code Changes

`verl.experimental.teacher_rollout` owns selection, configuration checks, source assignment, and rollout metrics. The shared trainer and TransferQueue retain small integration hooks. Teacher routing stays in the experimental agent loop; generation and scoring remain separate requests. Docs and tests cover the experimental API.

 **Author:** [Jacob Helwig](https://jacobhelwig.github.io/)
 
-Last updated: 10/03/2026.
+Last updated: 10/22/2026.
+
+## Experimental teacher-generated training rollouts
+
+This feature lives in `verl.experimental.teacher_rollout`; its API and supported configurations may change. It reuses the native trainer and existing teacher service.
+
+By default, the student generates every training response. Configure `distillation.rollout_source_selector` to let a user function choose the generation source. verl executes that choice; it does not prescribe a balancing rule. The selector runs on the trainer before worker fan-out, once per training submission, and returns one source for every prompt, worker chunk, and repeated response in that submission. Validation always generates with the student and does not call the selector.
+
+The function is loaded once from a Python module or file using `path` and `name`:
+
+```python
+def choose_source(*, batch, global_step, seed, teacher_steps=10):
+    # Treat the prompt TensorDict as read-only. Policy-specific options arrive as kwargs.
+    return "teacher" if global_step <= teacher_steps else "student"
+```
+
+```yaml
+distillation:
+  rollout_source_selector:
+    path: /path/to/my_policy.py
+    name: choose_source
+    kwargs:
+      teacher_steps: 10
+```
+
+The function must be synchronous and return exactly `"student"` or `"teacher"`. Invalid results and policy exceptions stop the submission before TransferQueue writes or generation; there is no silent fallback. `batch` contains the prompt data before response repetition. `global_step` is the restored training step, and `seed` is the configured rollout seed. The policy owns deterministic choices and any state it needs: verl does not checkpoint arbitrary callback state. Derive decisions from these inputs to preserve source choices across resume without consuming global RNG state. Generated text is not guaranteed to be bitwise reproducible. Per-example selection and token-level interleaving are outside this initial interface.
+
+Teacher generation and teacher scoring are separate requests to the existing teacher service. Generation uses the student's sampling parameters, EOS policy, and full response budget. Scoring evaluates the complete resulting sequence to provide the existing soft top-k targets. The student then minimizes the existing supervised forward-KL objective on the selected prefixes. Teacher-generated trajectories change the training-state distribution, so teacher-only or mixed training should not be described as pure student on-policy distillation. Teacher generation adds decoding cost alongside the existing scoring pass and does not imply a model-quality improvement.
+
+A configured selector requires native synchronous V1 training, one vLLM teacher, vLLM student rollout, text-only `single_turn_agent` inputs, matching student/teacher tokenizers and vocabulary, and `forward_kl_topk` with policy gradients and task rewards disabled. Keep both temperatures at `1.0` and `rollout.calculate_log_probs=False`. Custom agent loops, custom replay samplers, and refilling failed groups are rejected at startup. Other training features (critic, auxiliary KL/entropy objectives, rollout correction, score centering, router replay, speculative decoding, group filtering) are not validated with teacher-generated rollouts; do not combine them with a selector. These restrictions apply whenever a selector is configured, including when that policy happens to choose the student. With no selector, existing configurations retain their behavior.
+
+For a config-only setup, the built-in `select_source` in `verl/experimental/teacher_rollout.py` is a fixed-probability policy:
+
+```bash
+DISTILLATION_LOSS_MODE=forward_kl_topk USE_POLICY_GRADIENT=False \
+  bash examples/on_policy_distillation_trainer/run_qwen3_8b_fsdp.sh \
+  distillation.rollout_source_selector.path=pkg://verl.experimental.teacher_rollout \
+  distillation.rollout_source_selector.name=select_source \
+  +distillation.rollout_source_selector.kwargs.teacher_probability=1.0 \
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.temperature=1.0 \
+  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.calculate_log_probs=False \
+  distillation.distillation_loss.loss_max_clamp=null \
+  distillation.distillation_loss.log_prob_min_clamp=null
+```
+
+Use `0.5` in this example for batch mixing, `0.0` for a configured student-only policy, or omit the selector entirely for the ordinary student baseline. Replace the example function with a different policy without modifying the trainer. The launcher's model and GPU allocations are production-sized examples. `distillation/teacher_rollout_fraction` reports the fraction of real trajectories generated by the teacher; synthetic padding is excluded. Student staleness metrics include only student trajectories and are absent on teacher-only batches. The ordinary student old-logprob computation remains in place; teacher sampling probabilities are never used as student rollout probabilities.

+"""Experimental teacher-generated training rollouts for synchronous V1 distillation."""
+
+import math
+import random
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from functools import partial
+from typing import Any, Literal
+
+from omegaconf import DictConfig, OmegaConf

+
+def is_teacher_rollout_enabled(config: DictConfig) -> bool:
+    """Whether training may use a user-selected teacher generation source."""
+    return bool(OmegaConf.select(config, "distillation.rollout_source_selector.path"))
+
+
+def build_rollout_source_selector(config: DictConfig) -> Callable[..., Literal["student", "teacher"]] | None:
+    """Load a synchronous user function once; policies own their selection and reproducibility.
+
+    The function receives keyword arguments ``batch``, ``global_step``, and ``seed``,
+    plus configured kwargs. It returns one source for the entire submission.
+    No selector preserves the existing student generation path.
+    """
+    if not is_teacher_rollout_enabled(config):
+        return None
+    selector = config.distillation.rollout_source_selector
+    function = load_extern_object(selector.path, selector.name)
+    if not callable(function):
+        raise TypeError("distillation.rollout_source_selector must refer to a callable.")
+    kwargs = OmegaConf.to_container(selector.get("kwargs", OmegaConf.create({})), resolve=True)
+    return partial(function, **kwargs)
+
+
+def select_source(
+    *, batch: TensorDict, global_step: int, seed: int, teacher_probability: float = 1.0
+) -> Literal["student", "teacher"]:
+    """Built-in fixed-probability selector; draws from (seed, global_step) without touching global RNG state."""
+    if not math.isfinite(teacher_probability) or not 0.0 <= teacher_probability <= 1.0:
+        raise ValueError("teacher_probability must be finite and in [0, 1].")
+    if teacher_probability == 0.0:
+        return "student"
+    if teacher_probability == 1.0:
+        return "teacher"
+    draw = random.Random(f"teacher-rollout:{seed}:{global_step}").random()
+    return "teacher" if draw < teacher_probability else "student"
+
+
+def assign_rollout_source(
+    batch: TensorDict, selector: Callable[..., Literal["student", "teacher"]], *, global_step: int, seed: int
+) -> None:
+    """Select one source before TransferQueue publication and worker fan-out."""
+    source = selector(batch=batch, global_step=global_step, seed=seed)
+    if not isinstance(source, str) or source not in ("student", "teacher"):
+        raise ValueError("rollout_source_selector must return 'student' or 'teacher' for the entire submission.")
+    tu.assign_non_tensor_data(batch, "rollout_source", source)
+
+
+def get_student_rollout_tags(config: DictConfig, tags: list[dict], metrics: dict) -> list[dict]:
+    """Record the real teacher fraction and return student tags for staleness metrics."""
+    real_tags = [tag for tag in tags if not tag.get("is_padding", False)]
+    if is_teacher_rollout_enabled(config) and real_tags:
+        metrics["distillation/teacher_rollout_fraction"] = sum(
+            tag.get("rollout_source", "student") == "teacher" for tag in real_tags
+        ) / len(real_tags)
+    return [tag for tag in real_tags if tag.get("rollout_source", "student") == "student"]
+
+
+def validate_teacher_rollout_config(config: DictConfig) -> None:
+    """Fail before allocation when teacher generation would enter an unsupported training path."""
+    selector = OmegaConf.select(config, "distillation.rollout_source_selector")
+    if selector is None:
+        return
+    if not isinstance(selector, dict | DictConfig):
+        raise ValueError("distillation.rollout_source_selector must contain path, name, and optional kwargs.")
+    path, name = selector.get("path"), selector.get("name")
+    kwargs = selector.get("kwargs", {})
+    if (
+        bool(path) != bool(name)
+        or any(value is not None and (not isinstance(value, str) or not value) for value in (path, name))
+        or not isinstance(kwargs, dict | DictConfig)
+        or any(key in kwargs for key in ("batch", "global_step", "seed"))
+        or (not path and kwargs)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("distillation.rollout_source_selector requires a nonempty path/name pair and policy kwargs.")
+    if not path:
+        return
+
+    def require(path: str, expected: Any, default: Any = None) -> None:
+        if OmegaConf.select(config, path, default=default) != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f"A rollout_source_selector requires {path}={expected!r}.")
+
+    for path, expected, default in (
+        ("distillation.enabled", True, False),
+        ("trainer.use_v1", True, True),
+        ("trainer.v1.trainer_mode", "sync", "sync"),
+        ("actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name", "vllm", None),
+        ("actor_rollout_ref.rollout.agent.default_agent_loop", "single_turn_agent", "single_turn_agent"),
+        ("actor_rollout_ref.rollout.multi_turn.enable", False, False),
+        ("distillation.distillation_loss.loss_mode", "forward_kl_topk", None),
+        ("distillation.distillation_loss.use_policy_gradient", False, True),
+        ("distillation.distillation_loss.use_task_rewards", False, True),
+        ("actor_rollout_ref.rollout.calculate_log_probs", False, True),
+        ("actor_rollout_ref.rollout.temperature", 1.0, None),
+        ("trainer.v1.sampler.sync_refill_failed_groups", False, False),
+    ):
+        require(path, expected, default)
+    for path in (
+        "actor_rollout_ref.rollout.agent.agent_loop_manager_class",
+        "actor_rollout_ref.rollout.agent.agent_loop_config_path",
+        "trainer.v1.sampler.custom_sampler.path",
+        "trainer.v1.sampler.custom_sampler.name",
+    ):
+        if OmegaConf.select(config, path):
+            raise ValueError(f"A rollout_source_selector does not support {path}.")
+
+    topk = config.distillation.distillation_loss.topk
+    if topk is None or topk <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("A rollout_source_selector requires distillation.distillation_loss.topk > 0.")
+    teachers = config.distillation.teacher_models
+    # Match DistillationConfig._resolve_teacher_models: custom entries replace the default entry.
+    names = [name for name in teachers if name != "teacher_model"] if len(teachers) > 1 else list(teachers)
